Use `render_docx.py` to generate page PNGs (and optional PDF) for visual QA, then iterate until layout is flawless before delivering the final document. (file: r13/documents/26.1011.11113/skills/documents/SKILL.md)
- find-skills: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill. (file: r1/find-skills/SKILL.md)
- google-drive:google-docs: Prompt- and template-complete Google Docs creation and editing with explicit-instruction-authoritative structural preservation, including semantic roles, relationships, comparison dimensions, and instructed extensions; full-topology native-copy routing; source-grounded per-tab adaptation for past/example references; style-preserving hyperlink and table edits; canonical smart-chip-first authoring for dates and relevant supported people or Google resources; a file-backed advisory trusted read before existing-document writes; automatic protected-control awareness; direct connector APIs by default; DOCX-first import only when no supplied Google Doc template/reference constrains the output; and checked-in code mode only for exact native dropdown mutation. Use when Codex must create, edit, fill, adapt, redesign, or verify Google Docs without overriding explicit user/template instructions, adding unrequested document scope, or carrying stale reference facts into a new deliverable. (file: r9/google-docs/SKILL.md)
- google-drive:google-drive: Use connected Google Drive as the single entrypoint for Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides work. Use when the user wants to find, fetch, organize, share, export, copy, or delete Drive files, or summarize and edit Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides through one unified Google Drive plugin. (file: r9/google-drive/SKILL.md)
- google-drive:google-drive-comments: Write, reply to, and resolve Google Drive comments on Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive files with evidence-backed location context. Use when the user asks to leave comments, review a file with comments, respond to comment threads, or resolve Drive comments. (file: r9/google-drive-comments/SKILL.md)
- google-drive:google-sheets: Analyze and edit connected Google Sheets with range precision. Use when the user wants to create Google Sheets, find a spreadsheet, inspect tabs or ranges, search rows, plan formulas, create or repair charts, clean or restructure tables, write concise summaries, or make explicit cell-range updates. (file: r9/google-sheets/SKILL.md)
- google-drive:google-slides: Route Google Slides authoring requests and derive a design system from a native template or reference deck. Use this skill when the user provides an existing native Google Slides deck as a template, reference, or prior-period source, or asks to edit, update, repair, restyle, or clean up an existing native Google Slides deck. Use the Presentations skill instead for net-new presentation creation when no existing native Google Slides deck must be followed. (file: r9/google-slides/SKILL.md)
- hatch-pet: Create, repair, validate, visually QA, and package Codex-compatible v2 animated pets from character art, generated images, company or prospect brand cues, or visual references. Use for any new Codex pet, custom mascot, non-pixel pet style, brand-inspired pet, existing-pet repair, or 8x11 spritesheet workflow requiring all 9 standard animation rows, 16 look directions, deterministic assembly, QA artifacts, and spriteVersionNumber 2 packaging. (file: r0/hatch-pet/SKILL.md)

- maintain-agent-guidance: AGENTS、skill、agent guidance、永続化規則または過去taskの学びの保存・整理・監査をユーザーが明示的に依頼した場合に、候補を検証し適切な原典への変更を提案する。 (file: r1/maintain-agent-guidance/SKILL.md)

Use to set up or improve a tracker, choosing its fields and views from the user's needs; ordinary record updates belong to the task's workflow. (file: r10/notion-database-designer/SKILL.md)
- notion:notion-meeting-intelligence: Prepares Notion meeting agendas, pre-reads, decision briefs, and follow-up actions. Use for meeting preparation, carrying context into recurring meetings, or turning meeting outcomes into next steps. Simple meeting lookups or saving notes verbatim do not need this workflow. (file: r10/notion-meeting-intelligence/SKILL.md)
- notion:notion-research-documentation: Synthesizes Notion workspace evidence into cited answers, comparisons, briefs, or reports. Use to investigate a question, connect findings across sources, or reconcile conflicting information, with external research when useful. Simple lookups, fetching a known page, or summarizing one supplied page do not need this workflow. (file: r10/notion-research-documentation/SKILL.md)
- notion:notion-spec-to-implementation: Converts Notion product or technical specs into implementation plans, linked tasks, and evidence-based progress updates. Use for planning or implementing a spec, creating tasks from requirements, or reconciling implementation with spec changes. (file: r10/notion-spec-to-implementation/SKILL.md)
- notion:notion-weekly-project-digest: Produces evidence-based weekly project or team updates by comparing reporting periods, tasks, decisions, and blockers in Notion. Use for recurring status digests; use spec-to-implementation for requirement-level implementation tracking. (file: r10/notion-weekly-project-digest/SKILL.md)
- orca-linear: Linear ticket work through Orca's CLI.
